question: What is the enhanced credit limit under the Modified Interest Subvention Scheme (MISS) for Kisan Credit Card (KCC) loans as per the Union Budget, 2025–26?
solution:
The correct answer is __**₹5 lakh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the **Union Budget 2025–26**, the **Government of India** announced a significant enhancement in the credit limit for short-term agriculture loans provided under the **Modified Interest Subvention Scheme (MISS)**.
 
• The credit limit for **Kisan Credit Card (KCC)** loans has been increased from the existing **₹3 lakh** to **₹5 lakh** to meet the growing capital requirements of farmers.
 
• This enhancement aims to provide farmers with better access to **formal credit**, allowing them to invest in high-quality seeds, fertilizers, and modern agricultural machinery.
 
• The **Modified Interest Subvention Scheme (MISS)** is a central sector scheme that provides interest subvention to financial institutions to ensure that short-term crop loans are available at an **affordable interest rate**.
